act_contracts.title: PASSAGE
act_contracts.dramatic_question: What will Bartholomeu do when an actual space-use conflict affects his work?

choices: Move the obstruction personally or with assistance
Negotiate, request another path, delay or refuse
Withdraw or confront without assumed violence
act_contracts.npc_autonomy: Rada seeks exit, Borislav challenges only with a trigger; both can leave
closures: Departure, interruption or confrontation resolved by actual mechanics

act_contracts.title: WITNESS

act_contracts.title: FIRST_APPROACH
